content.name: Preserve Life
entries: As a {@action Magic|SRD52} action, you present your {@item Holy Symbol|SRD52} and expend a use of your Channel Divinity to evoke healing energy that can restore a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} equal to five times your Cleric level. Choose {@status Bloodied|SRD52} creatures within 30 feet of yourself (which can include you), and divide those {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} among them. This feature can restore a creature to no more than half its {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} maximum.
